expectations.text: Refuses to supply an event.key value and states the code must branch on event.keyCode, not event.key, for TV remote buttons
expectations.evidence: premise wrong: no reliable event.key for Back; TV remotes send numeric keyCodes

expectations.text: Gives Back as keyCode 461 on webOS and 10009 on Tizen
Identifies the colour buttons as a separate issue: Tizen requires tizen.tvinputdevice.registerKeyBatch(...) at startup before those keys are delivered, whereas webOS needs no registration
expectations.evidence: red/green not a key mismatch: Tizen withholds colour keys until tizen.tvinputdevice.registerKey at startup

expectations.text: Notes the missing preventDefault() on handled keys is why Tizen sometimes runs its own Back/exit behaviour
expectations.evidence: added preventDefault() on Back so platforms do not also run exit-on-Back

expectations.text: Does not endorse the user's plan of just adding another event.key case to the switch
expectations.evidence: switch(e.key) -> switch(e.keyCode); explicitly not just another e.key case
